+    if stderr:
+        expected.append((usertypes.MessageLevel.error, 'stderr text'))
         assert proc.stderr.strip() == "stderr text", proc.stderr
 
+    messages = [(msg.level, msg.text) for msg in message_mock.messages]

+        expected, key=lambda msg: msg[1])
+    assert messages[len(expected):] == expected
+
+
+def test_live_stderr(proc, qtbot, caplog, message_mock, py_proc):
+    proc._output_messages = True
+    cmd, args = py_proc("""
+        import sys, time
+        sys.stderr.write('first error\\n')
+        sys.stderr.flush()
+        time.sleep(0.5)
+        sys.stderr.write('second error\\n')
+    """)
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=5000):
+            with qtbot.wait_signal(proc._proc.readyReadStandardError,
+                                   timeout=5000):
+                proc.start(cmd, args)
+            assert proc.outcome.running
+            assert [(msg.level, msg.text) for msg in message_mock.messages] == [
+                (usertypes.MessageLevel.error, 'first error')]
+
+    assert all(msg.level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
+               for msg in message_mock.messages)
+    assert message_mock.messages[-1].text == 'first error\nsecond error'
+    assert proc.stderr == 'first error\nsecond error\n'
+
+
+def test_empty_ready_read(proc, qtbot, py_proc, message_mock):
+    proc._output_messages = True
+    cmd, args = py_proc('import time; time.sleep(0.1)')
+    with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=5000):
+        proc.start(cmd, args)
+        proc._on_stdout_ready_read()
+        proc._on_stderr_ready_read()
+    assert not message_mock.messages
+
